FULL TEXT:
Advertisement for the Post of Research Associate
Advertisement Reference No. : GNLU/AC/FP-011/2024 dated 24/06/2024
ICSSR Funded under major Research Project
Applications are invited for the position of Research Associate purely on a tenure (temporary)
basis at the Gujarat National Law University, Gandhinagar. The post is created under the Research
Project, sanctioned by the Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), New Delhi, under
the ICSSR Major and Minor Projects. The details of the position for the above Project, with
Consolidated Salary & Eligibility Conditions, are given below:
Research Project
Title
Resilience of Swachhata Entrepreneurs in Advancing Sanitation and
Waste Management for Achieving Swachh Bharat Mission and United
Nations Sustainable Development Goals
Position Research Associate
Duration 12 Months (it can be extended to six more months if performance is
good. Otherwise, the position can be terminated at any time.
No. of Positions 01 (Only one)
Job Description To carry out the research work, which includes rigorous review writing,
fieldwork, data analysis, report writing, project-related documentation,
and any other work as assigned by the Project Principal Investigator.
Essential
Qualification
1. Master Degree in Social Work / Entrepreneurship/Social
Sciences with UGC NET
or
1. PhD in above mentioned fields.
Desirable
Qualification
1. Excellent data analysis and report writing skills
2. The candidate with prior experience of research in social
entrepreneurship / Innovations / WASH Sector/SDGs will be
preferred
Emoluments Rs. 47,000/ per month (consolidated)
How to Apply 1. Interested and eligible candidates are informed to submit the
following documents through email to the Project Director
following email anrao@gnlu.ac.in
a. Covering letter for justifying your candidature for this
position
b. Curriculum Vitae with the details of educational
qualifications
c. Attach at least two research publications (if any)
2. Only complete application will be considered. The email title
should be “Research Associate for ICSSR Major Project”
3. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for the interview by email
only.
4. The interview will be held online.
5. The selection of the candidates shall be provisional and subject
to the fulfillment of eligibility criteria and verification of the
original documents.
6. The selected candidate will be expected to join at the earliest.
7. The rules and regulations of Gujarat National Law University
and ICSSR will guide the Terms and conditions of the
appointment.
8. The last date to apply is 8th July 2024.
9. For any further query the candidate may contact:
Dr Ambati Nageswara Rao,
Assistant Professor of Social Work,
Gujarat National Law University, Gandhinagar, Gujarat,
Email ID: anrao@gnlu.ac.in
